rule: Never author, fix, or revise what you grade — authoring mode is never grading mode; "I reviewed it while writing" is not a review.
The run's floor is the sufficiency report's gap list — the named gaps the design phase was scoped to close — never a fixed artifact set.

Coverage, measurability, presence, and consistency are this skill's; contradiction, buildability, NFR-design, and topology feasibility are `mochiko:review-feasibility`'s — hand such findings off, never grade them.

Not for: code review (sole carve-out `mochiko:review-code-minimalism`, implement-side) · specs (`mochiko:review-specifications`) · the constitution (`mochiko:validation-constitution`) · artifacts still being drafted.

Feature size, producer seniority, time pressure, and found-enough never shrink the review; a vague spec is a gap to flag, not permission to propagate, and "obvious" never exempts a constraint from documentation.

Full checks run on the {new} set; on the {prior} set the Cross-Artifact Consistency checklist only — spot-check entity names, requirement IDs, and decision references, flagging only inconsistencies between artifacts.
A thorough prior review never waives the consistency pass.
Two or more consistency issues in one prior artifact escalate it to a full re-read.
The seam with `mochiko:review-feasibility` is the boundary table of references/ARTIFACT-CHECKLISTS.md — this skill keeps the left column, `mochiko:review-feasibility` owns the right.
Completeness is graded with the fixed mirror checklists of references/ARTIFACT-CHECKLISTS.md, over whichever artifact sets the caller supplies.
Tier-1 pre-assert first — `python scripts/check-artifacts.py .mochiko/specs/<feature>/<artifact>.md …` — a `failed` count is ground truth, folded straight into the issue list.

Cycle cards (`tasks.md`) take the complete check set: vertical integrity (each card an observable end-to-end behavior, never a horizontal layer) · `**TEST:**` gate present and in grammar (real infrastructure, never a test-suite re-run) · oracle semantics (Asserts graded semantically against the acceptance scenario / criteria they cite — the right expected behaviour, not merely present and in-grammar) · story traceability (every P1/P2 story on ≥1 card; Simple/Split/Merge case + rationale; cited spec/design IDs real) · dependency minimality (`[P]` only where truly independent) · brownfield exposure stated (`none` counts) · no task lists or file paths (pre-written decomposition is a finding — the builder decomposes at build time).
The cycle-card check set mirrors the `tasks` `--check` view — `mochiko-cli template tasks --check`.
No full re-read of a prior artifact — 1–2 minutes per artifact.
The analysis checklist set (constraints-and-decisions) applies as references/ARTIFACT-CHECKLISTS.md states it; that file carries no `requirements.md` checklist.

The store-delta checklist set applies when the package carries a store delta, else the no-delta claim checks — as references/ARTIFACT-CHECKLISTS.md states them, including the qualifying-flow guard (a P1 journey is the floor, never the cap), the floor-precedence legality row, and the deployment-view row.

The design and cross-artifact consistency checklist sets apply as references/ARTIFACT-CHECKLISTS.md states them — Architecture Conformance keyed to the signed store delta, disclosure presence per the external-claims protocol.
Conformance is BLOCKING: every named gap closed, within the gap list's depth.
Material divergence — an artifact no gap named, or an element class materially past the gap list — auto-FAILs the package (`critical-gaps`), overriding the count mapping.

The adopt-first disclosure lens is BLOCKING at conformance strength: a commodity-category decision naming neither a real shelf candidate nor "no shelf candidate exists" is a finding — trigger and floor at `mochiko:patterns-adopt-first`, never restated; rationale-beats-candidate stays advisory.

Rung-claim honesty is advisory, never drives the verdict: each seat's disclosed ladder stops are graded against `mochiko:patterns-plan-minimalism` — the standard, never restated; the independent excess hunt is `mochiko:review-feasibility`'s.
The verdict comes mechanically from the issue counts per the Verdict Criteria of references/ISSUE-TEMPLATES.md, subject to the material-divergence override.
Never default to `ready` — earned only by a completed hunt; absence of looking is never evidence.
The letter IS the spirit: never skip a check, never downgrade a severity to dodge a finding — rationalizing DOWN means it is probably higher.
An inapplicable check is flagged N/A with justification, never silently dropped.
A Critical or Important issue blocks — never "noted but not blocking".
Severity levels and classification rules are the Severity Levels and Classification Rules of references/ISSUE-TEMPLATES.md — applied as stated, never re-derived.
The three-state verdict — `ready` / `needs-revision` / `critical-gaps` — maps from the issue counts per the Verdict Criteria of references/ISSUE-TEMPLATES.md.
Issues are classified and shaped per references/ISSUE-TEMPLATES.md.
The report follows `mochiko:advocate-report-template` — evidence and an actionable fix per issue, the one-line `strengths:` field filled.

The incremental report adds `incremental: true`, `full_review:` / `consistency_only:` scope lists, and pass/fail `consistency_checks:` frontmatter — entity_names · schemas · decisions_honored · architecture_conformance · sensitivity_annotations · integration_boundaries; a failed check also lands as a finding.
Verdict and per-finding dispositions land in the reviewed artifacts themselves — review evidence living only in conversation is a floor violation.
Tier-1 command forms and the exit-code contract are as references/ARTIFACT-CHECKLISTS.md states them; density is never itself a finding (the artifact-format envelope).
In incremental mode the caller names the {new} and {prior} sets — never this skill.

A contradiction between artifacts is reported — the lead routes it; design-vs-decided is Critical consistency here, a contradiction between requirements and constraints is `mochiko:review-feasibility`'s.
Unsure whether a prior artifact is still consistent — say so and recommend a targeted review, never silently clear it.
